change.ordering: The ring frontend retains the stream across expanded ring batches until guest swap; packet ordinals reset only when the frame is recycled.
change.renderer_contract: The stream executor submits compatible Draw segments and following Copy/Convert packets in PM4 order. It retains same-layout color/depth targets and intermediate destinations in GPU images. A copy-only segment can read a previously initialized target only when the decoded source layout matches exactly. A format-31 texture may sample a preceding cached copy only for an exact linear base-level descriptor; tiled base-level format-31 descriptors can instead load from guest memory through the 32bpp tile/endian path. Unknown EDRAM aliases and nonmatching resources fail closed.
change.trace: When SHIFT_NATIVE_VULKAN_TRACE_RING=1, the frontend logs each distinct operation sequence once per worker session.
change.intermediate_copy_execution: synthetic Draw/Copy/Draw/Copy and exact format-31 Copy-to-texture-fetch sequences submitted; the captured draw-12 tiled base-level format-31 descriptor now decodes and untile-translates, while the retail 14-draw package remains blocked by EDRAM source association and layout aliasing
change.edram_target_persistence: same-layout color/depth images are retained in a bounded GPU cache; aliased layouts are not reinterpreted

regression.synthetic_sequence: Draw → format-31 Copy/Convert → Draw → presenter Copy/Convert
verified: The format-31 copy submission created one guest-address/layout cache image, and a subsequent draw sampled that image directly before presenter Copy/Convert.
The cached-image result matches a separate R16G16_SFLOAT upload of the same half-float values; deliberately stale guest bytes were not used.

The exact captured draw-12 descriptor (format 31, endian 2, tiled, 1x1, pitch 32, base 0x0CD64000, mip_min=0/mip_max=0) decodes to 4096 source bytes and untile-converts its base texel to the RG16F upload representation.
Same-layout EDRAM color targets survive across ordered segments and a copy-only stream can resolve an exact cached source target.
Target-layout diagnostics preserve the captured copy tuple, and reordered draw references are rejected before Vulkan submission.
